responsibility: Declares the derive expander specialized for builtin #[derive(Debug)] in the Rust expansion subsystem. It introduces the DeriveDebug visitor class, its go entry point, and the helpers that build the stub fmt associated function and enclosing core::fmt::Debug impl, along with shape-specific visit hooks for structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions so macro expansion can synthesize Debug implementations for supported item kinds.
same_name_distinction: Header counterpart to rust-derive-debug.cc: it declares the DeriveDebug visitor class, go entry point, and stub-building helpers used for #[derive(Debug)] expansion, but does not contain the AST-construction logic that the .cc file implements.
